newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland extends Ozarow cable firm bids deadline.
newsitem.headline: Poland extends Ozarow cable firm bids deadline.

text.p: Poland extended bids for up to 10 percent stakes in cable maker Fabryka Kabli Ozarow SA to October 11, the privatisation ministry said in a newspaper announcement.
Earlier the ministry set the deadline for September 20.
The ministry wants to sell 75 percent in Ozarow, near Warsaw, while 20 percent are earmarked for employees and five percent for a planned fund to meet claims for property confiscated under communism.
The ministry did not reveal any financial data of the company. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
